item.title: Tecnologo: LW-ROPS - LIGHT-WEIGHT ROPS FOR SMALL AGRICULTURAL SELF-PROPELLED MACHINERY and MATEE - MULTIFUNCTIONAL AGRICULTURAL TRACTOR ENERGY EXTENDER (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-04 Ingegneria agraria, forestale e dei biosistemi

The activity focuses on the development of a multifunctional towed prototype for solar energy management for electric tractors (MATEE) and the design of lightweight protective structures for selfpropelled machines weighing less than 400 kg (LW-ROPS). The activities include: - Technical support for the mechanical/kinematic design (including FEM analysis) of prototype components/parts and test equipment. - Technical support for assessing the rollover stability of agroforestry vehicles and towed equipment, through simulations and experimental tests in a controlled environment. - Technical support for the execution and analysis of experimental and simulated tests on ROPS protective structures.…

item.title: Tecnologo: Innovative and precision food fermentation (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-08 Microbiologia agraria, alimentare e ambientale

Management and support of innovative fermentation processes aimed at the valorization and recycling of food by-products, the use of alternative raw materials, and the development of products and processes with high nutritional value. Activities include the organization and management of laboratory use, the selection of starter cultures based on metabolic and technological properties, microbiome modelling, and the optimization of fermentation protocols.
